verses.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਪੁਛਣਿ ਸਿਧ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: fir puchhan sidh naanakaa maat lok vich kiaa varataaraa|

en.bdb: Siddhs again asked, (O Nanak! How are the dealings on mother earth?).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸਿਧੀ ਇਹ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਕਲਿ ਤਾਰਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: sabh sidhee ieh bujhiaa kal taaran naanak avataaraa|

en.bdb: By this time all the siddhs understood that Nanak had come to earth to deliver it from the (sins of) kaliyug.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੇ ਆਖਿਆ ਨਾਥ ਜੀ ਸਚੁ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾਂ ਕੂੜੁ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: baabe aakhiaa naath jee sach cha(n)dhramaa(n) kooR a(n)dhaaraa|

en.bdb: Baba replied, (O respected Nath, the truth is dim like the moon and the falsehood like deep darkness).

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਅਮਾਵਸਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਹਉ ਭਾਲਣਿ ਚੜ੍ਹਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kooR amaavas varatiaa hau bhaalan chaRihaa sa(n)saaraa|

en.bdb: The darkness of the moonless night of the falsehood has spread around and I, in order to search for the (truthful) world, have undertaken this journey.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪਿ ਗਿਰਾਸੀ ਪਿਰਥਮੀ ਧਉਲੁ ਖੜਾ ਧਰਿ ਹੇਠ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: paap giraasee pirathamee dhaul khaRaa dhar heTh pukaaraa|

en.bdb: The earth is engrossed with sin and its support, the dharma in the form of ox is crying and wailing (for rescue).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਛਪਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਪਰਬਤੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: sidh chhap baiThe parabatee kaun jagat kau paar utaaraa|

en.bdb: In such circumstances, when siddhs, the adepts, (by becoming repudiators) have taken refuge in the  mountains, how the world could get redeemed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਲਗਾਏ ਛਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: jogee giaan vihooniaa nis dhin a(n)g lagaae chhaaraa|

en.bdb: Yogis also bereft of knowledge and simply applying ashes to their bodies are lying down unconcerned.
Without Guru the world is getting drowned.
